topic.title: Evaluate expressions in the Node.js REPL

task.title: Start the REPL as a surface

step.cmd: Start node -i as a process named sessions-repl, and wait for the > prompt.
In the REPL, enter 40 + 2 and press Enter. Wait for the REPL to print 42.

task.title: Run the REPL in the background

step.cmd: Run node -i in the background as a process named sessions-bg-repl, and wait for the > prompt.
In the REPL, enter Math.pow(2, 10) and press Enter. Wait for the REPL to print 1024.
